supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40:04 UTC, WS-ARUIZ-01 obtained Kerberos tickets as its machine account; shortly afterward it connected to DC-PIN-01 over SMB and established a network logon as WS-ARUIZ-01$.
The SMB session to DC-PIN-01 ended at 13:40:36 UTC; these records do not identify a PowerShell process or show what activity occurred over SMB.

At 13:42:09 UTC, DC-PIN-01 recorded a service ticket for raj.patel to WS-ARUIZ-01$, originating from 10.51.10.23. This is consistent with access from WS-RPATEL-01, but does not establish that it caused the reported window or what command, if any, was run.
The supplied process records show taskhostw.exe at 14:15:33 and conhost.exe at 14:17:16, with conhost.exe parented by csrss.exe; they do not document the reported PowerShell window around 13:40.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records do not include process-creation telemetry for the reported time around 13:40, nor command-line, PowerShell script-block, or console-session evidence for that time.
The SMB connection records establish a connection and network logon, but do not expose the SMB share, accessed files, or commands.
The raj.patel service-ticket record does not by itself show a successful interactive or remote logon, command execution, or a causal link to the reported window.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually ran on WS-ARUIZ-01 around 13:40 UTC, and, if so, its command line, script contents, parent process, and initiating account.
Whether the 13:40 SMB session or the later raj.patel service ticket was related to the reported window.
Whether the activity was authorized workstation patching or malicious activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve complete endpoint process-creation and PowerShell logging for WS-ARUIZ-01 around 13:20–14:20 UTC, including command lines, parent-child relationships, script-block logs, and console history if available.
Correlate WS-RPATEL-01 remote-administration logs and raj.patel's activity with the 13:40–13:42 events; confirm whether a patch operation was initiated and what target and commands it used.
Review SMB server/share auditing on DC-PIN-01 for the 13:40 session to identify the accessed share and files.
unrelated_findings: At 14:06 UTC, DC-PIN-01 recorded an NTLM validation for ana.ruiz with Workstation=DC-PIN-01, and WS-RPATEL-01 recorded a network logon for ana.ruiz with the source address of DC-PIN-01. This cross-host authentication pattern is unexplained by the supplied records and should be investigated separately; it does not establish anything about the reported 13:40 activity. (T064-00242, T064-00243)
